scope: Frontend i18n targeting prompts (de/it/pt); targeting-overlay caption composition path + shipped locale strings. No game-state pair exists for a UI-only report.
result: The reported wrongness (hardcoded gendered article composed at runtime with the noun: 'eine Spieler', 'un creatura', 'um criatura') does not reproduce on current main. PR #7806 replaced the runtime article+noun composition with whole-phrase per-noun keys; de/it/pt now render agreeing articles for the reported nouns (de 'einen Spieler'/'eine Kreatur', it 'una creatura', pt 'uma criatura').
limitations: UI-only subsystem; tested against current main frontend sources, not a pinned engine release.
Locale-string level verification of actual shipped data and the actual composition code path; no browser render (rendering is irrelevant to grammatical article agreement).
Agreement judged by standard grammar tables; native-speaker confirmation (requested in the issue) was not performed.
es/fr/pl/other locales not in the report were not re-checked noun-by-noun.
